title: Deriving the Identity sin(x + pi/2) = cos x
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Use the trigonometric addition formulas to derive the identity \sin(x + \pi/2) = \cos x.

steps.title: Apply the Sine Addition Formula
steps.explanation: Expand sin(x + pi/2) using the identity sin(A + B) = sin A cos B + cos A sin B with A = x and B = pi/2.
steps.why: The sine addition formula holds for all real numbers A and B.

steps.title: Substitute Exact Values at pi/2
steps.explanation: Use the unit circle values cos(pi/2) = 0 and sin(pi/2) = 1.
steps.why: An angle of pi/2 radians terminates at (0, 1) on the unit circle.

steps.title: Simplify to Obtain cos x
steps.explanation: The first product vanishes and the second equals cos x, completing the derivation.
steps.why: 0 + cos x simplifies identically to cos x.
